messages.text:
I can't refund all three napkins today. The shop's records show only two of them as received back (refund-policy/v2/return).

- **Units 1 and 2:** Both are received back. Each was paid 91.00 BRL, so the refund would be 182.00 BRL in total.
- **Unit 3:** The shop has no return record for it. The shop refunds only units it has received back, so nothing can be paid for this one yet (refund-policy/v2/return).

**How the discount is split:** Each unit's refund is what was paid for that unit, which is its price minus its share of the discount (refund-policy/v2/amount). When identical units share a paid total, each gets the total divided by the number of units, rounded down to the smallest currency unit. Any remainder goes one smallest unit at a time to the last units. The shares are fixed when the order is recorded and never recalculated. Shipping isn't part of the refund amount. Your three napkins were each recorded at 91.00 BRL.

**Next steps:**
- Would you like me to propose a refund for units 1 and 2 (182.00 BRL)? If so, you'd confirm it with the button on the proposal card, and then a staff member would review it (refund-policy/v2/approval).
- If you haven't sent unit 3 yet, it must arrive back first. The refund deadline for this order is 2026-12-04 10:00 UTC (refund-policy/v2/window).
- If you already sent unit 3, tell me and a staff member will check.
